programme.desc: 'S1/E74'. Lwandle struggles to rebuild relationships after her disappearance, while Senzo grows closer to Londiwe and strains his marriage further.

programme.title: Durban Gen
programme.desc: 'S1/E68 - 1/68'. Mchunu tries saving the day and the unthinkable happens - someone dies in the process.

programme.title: Rhythm City
programme.desc: 'S1/E99 - 99'. The battle between the real power brokers of the music industry: the record companies, promoters, producers, DJs and the stars - but also the wannabe stars, the has-beens, families and lovers.

programme.title: Twist of Fate
programme.desc: 'S3/E65'. Pragya reveals to Aliya and Tanu that she is the real Pragya and not Munni. She recounts all the misdeeds done by Aliya and Tanu in the past. Outside the room, Simonika eavesdrops on the conversation.

programme.title: India: A Love Story
programme.desc: 'S1/E124'. Showing the great differences between the cultures of India and Brazil, the story focuses on the forbidden passion between two very different Indians of origin.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S1/E39'. There's a fire at the hospital and everything turns to chaos. In the middle of it all, Bahar jumps in to help with Leyla's case.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E33'. Daghan tries to help an old teacher. Enver is fighting the Zakkum brothers, and Mesut has a big scare.

programme.title: Bittersoet
programme.desc: 'S2/E4'. When Emir goes to extreme lengths to ensure Nihan returns from her overseas refuge, Nihan does the unimaginable in revenge. Kemal is released from prison.

programme.title: Sout van die Aarde
programme.desc: 'S2/E14'. Can Zahide's plan help Dilek and Taner to get married sooner? Wessel and Taner arrange a wedding in one day. Sefer searches for work and Ramazan deals with his heartbreak.

programme.title: Entertainment Set
programme.desc: Entertainment highlights, news and reviews.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S2/E93'. Yaman, a ruthless businessman, raises his nephew Yusuf after his brother's death. When Seher, Yusuf's caring aunt, enters their lives, love and conflict collide.

programme.title: 'n Ma se Hart
programme.desc: 'S1/E13'. Melike confronts Berrin about Duru' hospital records. Kerim discovers important information about the Aksoy' business. Cengiz is suspicious about Kadir' relationship with Melike.

programme.title: Op 'n Afgrond
programme.desc: 'S1/E12'. A scandal over Cihan's engagement sparks chaos, followed by Samet defending the family in a public fight. As tensions rise and suspicions grow about Melek and Nuh, Hikmet's heart attack deepens the crisis within the family.

programme.title: Lente Na Die Storm
programme.desc: 'S1/E40'. Bahar meets an eccentric divorce attorney but Timur and Nevra's agendas threaten to hinder her progress. Selen struggles to process a shocking revelation.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E34'. Gurkan finds Husniye collapsed and rushes her to the hospital. Meanwhile, Cezmi is released on bail. Daghan leaves a gift for Gurkan and the Zakkum Brothers, which ended up in a surprise for himself.

programme.title: Die Put
programme.desc: 'S1/E20'. Vartolu finally shows his true colours to the people of The Pit and blackmails them into working for him.
